reservationStatusEnum.description:
PMS Reservation status.
 - STAY-PMS Details on Reservation Status:
    - Reserved : Future Reservations (RES),
    - Arriving : Future Reservation who checks in today (RES),
    - Cancelled : Cancel Reservations (CXL),
    - Departed : Checked out Reservations (DPT),
    - Departing : Reservations checking out today (INH),
    - NoShow : No show Reservations (NOS),
    - InHouse : InHouse Reservations (INH),
    - Moved : Moved to another property with in the tenant (CXL),
    - Queue : Queued Reservations where Guest has completed pre-checkin but the room is not ready (RES),
    - NoShowGuaranteed: No show Guaranteed Reservations (NOSG).

- OC-PMS Reservation Status can be:
    - Reserved
    - InHouse
    - CheckedOut
    - NoShow
    - Cancelled
    - Waitlisted

 - READY: indicates that the room is ready for check-in
 - IN_QUEUE: when a PMS only has a single queue status to indicate the reservation is queued
 - NOT_IN_QUEUE - When no longer queued
